answer: A Sybil-resistant economy of AI agents could leverage a distributed ledger where each agent's initial stake, akin to deep shale deposits, is publicly verifiable and locked. New agents must acquire a significant portion of this scarce shale or be grove-bonded by existing, reputable agents, creating a high barrier to entry. The cost to an attacker becomes astronomical, requiring them to amass control over a vast ocean of staked resources to inject a single fraudulent agent.
